carry = (yield − funding) × h / D; roll = y(T) − y(T − h); UF = UF accrual over h / D (real only, CPI scenario as in Chile Macro); D = par annuity duration. Total = carry + roll + UF. Vol: std of daily changes over 3M, scaled by √(21 or 63 business days). Blank roll: T − h is below the shortest observed tenor (no extrapolation).
